slots.name: celebration duration
slots.sentence: The Houston-based couple Dr. Alisha Sadhwani Tyle, 29, a pediatrician, and Sujay Tyle, 32, a technology entrepreneur and co-owner of the Portland Trail Blazers, also made sure their playlist spanned generations at their three-day wedding celebrations at Fairmont Udaipur Palace in Udaipur, India, which coincided with New Year’s Eve last year.

slots.name: number of after-parties
slots.sentence: The D.J.s at all three Boiler Room-themed after-parties balanced throwback hits for older relatives with crowd favorites from artists like Drake and Rihanna.
